## Amounts and the stage fold (no switch) {#sec-ch10-amounts}

### Summary

An amount is how much of each conserved row a named mechanism changed during a step: the seam reconciliation, the
wall prescription, a cell source. The register books an amount stage by stage, but a stage's change does not enter
the step's state with weight one: the Runge-Kutta combination scales it. The monitor keeps each stage's booking in
its own slot and folds them with the stage weights only when someone reads the amounts.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** The step amount of each name, $\mathbf M_k = \sum_s c^{(s)} (w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathbf a^{(s)}_k +
\mathbf p^{(s)}_k)$ ([-@eq-ch10-amounts-fold]).

**Data.** Per stage and name: booked rates $\mathbf a^{(s)}_k$ and weighted posts $\mathbf p^{(s)}_k$, one value per
row, FP64 (FP32 on MPS).

**Placement.** Booked inside the stages; `end_stage` records the weights; folded on the device at each read.

**Activation.** Always; the three flux corrections exist from reset, a cell source's name at its first post.

**Guarantee / limits.** The fold equals the step field's recursion (@eq-ch10-amounts-recursion).

**Evidence.** The Tests layer of this section.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathbf a^{(s)}_k$ is the rate booked for amount $k$ in stage $s$ (a flux times an area, per unit
time); $\mathbf p^{(s)}_k$ is a post already in amount units; $c^{(s)}$ is the product of the later stages' $w_1$;
$\mathbf M_k$ is the step amount; $\mathbf S_d$ is the step field of direction $d$.

### Derivation

A stage of the integrator updates $\mathbf U \leftarrow w_0^{(s)}\mathbf U^n + w_1^{(s)}\mathbf U + w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,
\mathcal L(\mathbf U)$. A face rate $\mathbf a^{(s)}$ booked in stage $s$ enters that stage's update with weight
$w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$, and every later stage $s' > s$ multiplies the running state by $w_1^{(s')}$. The step's share of
it is therefore

$$
c^{(s)} = \prod_{s' > s} w_1^{(s')}, \qquad
\mathbf M_k = \sum_s c^{(s)}\left(w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathbf a^{(s)}_k + \mathbf p^{(s)}_k\right).
$$ {#eq-ch10-amounts-fold}

The fold is {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::fold_ >}}.

A post $\mathbf p^{(s)}_k$ is a change already in the state (or already weighted by its caller), so it takes only
the later stages' $w_1$. The step field obeys the same weights as a recursion, stage by stage,

$$
\mathbf S_d \leftarrow w_1^{(s)}\mathbf S_d + w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathbf T_d ,
$$ {#eq-ch10-amounts-recursion}

The recursion is {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::end_stage >}}.

which unrolls to $\sum_s c^{(s)} w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathbf T^{(s)}_d$: the fold of ([-@eq-ch10-amounts-fold]) is the
same sum for the amounts. For a constant rate the weights sum to $\Delta t$, as @fig-ch10-stage-fold shows for the
three-stage scheme.

### Numerical method

`end_stage` records the stage's $w_1$ and $w_2\Delta t$ (a device value in a captured stage) and launches nothing.
A read of the amounts runs one device fold over the stages ended so far: the posts of a stage still open count at
once, its rates wait for its $w_2\Delta t$. The folded result is written into a fixed tensor, so a captured stage
and a replay read the same storage.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch10-stage-fold
#| fig-cap: "The fold coefficients of the three-stage strong-stability-preserving Runge-Kutta weights: the product of the later stages' w1, the weight of a booked rate and the weight of a post. The rate weights sum to the step."
#| fig-alt: "A table of three rows, one per stage, giving the coefficient c, the rate weight and the post weight; a note below says the rate weights sum to the time step."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch10.figures.fig_stage_fold import make_fig
make_fig()
```

: The code of amounts and the stage fold. {#tbl-ch10-amounts-code}

Walk-through: the three flux-correction names (`reconcile.x1`, `reconcile.panel`, `boundary.prescribed`) are made at
reset; `post` makes a cell source's name at its first post with its kind and stops on a second kind for the same
name. The amounts live on the register's device in the wide dtype; the cast happens on the host before a move,
because MPS has no FP64.

### Limits

The fold reads only the stages ended this step, so an amount read inside a stage misses that stage's rates until it
ends. The fixer, source and residual columns of the budget are not read from these amounts yet
(@sec-ch10-budget). Switch combinations are in @sec-ch12-matrix.
